title: Associativity of ordinary pro-etale tensor pullback
statement: Let X,Y be schemes in universe u, let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, and let R and S be commutative ring sheaves with values in universe u+1 on their small pro-etale sites, and c:f⁻¹R≅S. Let L be ordinary module pullback and μ its unit-generator-normalized tensor comparison [def-sp-proetale-ordinary-tensor-pullback-total]. For arbitrary module sheaves M,N,H on Y, L(α(M,N,H)) ; μ(M,N⊗H) ; (1⊗μ(N,H)) = μ(M⊗N,H) ; (μ(M,N)⊗1) ; α(LM,LN,LH), with traversal-order composition. No flatness or derived localization is involved.

proof.text: Apply the injective adjunction hom-equivalence and use naturality of its unit to move the source associator to the start. Maps from the ordinary triple tensor are detected by local pure triples. On a pure triple use the ordinary associator formula, the unit-generator comparison equation twice, and the tensor-map formula. Both routes give the same reassociated triple of unit images.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback_associativity {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (M N H : proEtaleRingModules Y R) :
    let L := proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c
    let μ := proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback f R S c
    L.map (α_ M N H).hom ≫ (μ M (N ⊗ H)).hom ≫
      (𝟙 (L.obj M) ⊗ₘ (μ N H).hom) =
    (μ (M ⊗ N) H).hom ≫ ((μ M N).hom ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (L.obj H)) ≫
      (α_ (L.obj M) (L.obj N) (L.obj H)).hom
